notes.title: Update to V1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello Community!
In this version, we’ve addressed some key issues:

-Fixed the loading screen.
-Resolved a bug that could prevent players from descending to the second level.
-Other minor fixes for a smoother experience.

As always, we want to extend a huge thank you for your ongoing support. We’re a small team, and your encouragement means the world to us. 🙂

Stay tuned for more updates!

The W.O.T Team

notes.title: Performance and quality update
notes.content:
Hello, community! 😊

We hope you had a fantastic summer full of stories to share. We're excited to bring you an important new update for D.N.A: Do Not Answer.

In this update, we focused heavily on improving performance. After a lot of hard work, we’ve optimized the system to boost frame rates by over 100%. These improvements include:

-A new, highly enhanced occlusion culling system
-Better management of shadows and reflections
-More efficient rendering of distant objects
-Shading and lighting optimization

You should now experience much smoother gameplay! 🎮

In addition to performance enhancements, we’ve fixed several bugs, including issues with colliders, and added a new menu that lets you adjust some quality settings to suit your preferences.

We sincerely thank you for your patience with the initial release. Your support and feedback mean the world to us, and they help us make the game better. ❤️ Rest assured, we’re continually working to further optimize the game and bring you new surprises!

We also have exciting plans to involve the community in some in-game decisions before the full release, so stay tuned!

Sincerly,

The W.O.T Team

notes.title: D.N.A V.1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey all!

First and foremost, we want to extend a heartfelt thank you for your support and reports! Your positive feedback on D.N.A means the world to us, and we are genuinely grateful. You can be assured that we are working hard to improve the game by continuing to fix bugs and enhance the overall experience.

In this minor release, we have started to address some minor issues. You can expect more updates in the coming weeks!

Thank you for being an amazing community. Keep gaming on!

With gratitude,
The W.O.T Team
